title: BuildingOS runtime.yaml
description: BuildingOS tenant runtime-parameter schema (M0 draft) — the single source of truth for tool registration (Q3 layering) plus engine/model/interface selection. Compiles to Codex config.toml and DSH cordis.yml/presets. Based on docs/api-contract.md Appendix A.

engine.description: Adopted engine (engines are pluggable). Adopting a new engine is a community review (M4+); the enum is extended then.

model.description: Provider-agnostic model handle. → Codex model; → DSH model configuration.

name.description: Server name, unique within the tenant; skills' dependencies.value references this name.

env.description: Environment variable overrides (sensitive values never enter Git; injected at deployment — D21).

mcp_servers.description: MCP server registration (Q3 layering: the single source of truth). All skills' dependencies.value must resolve here (bidirectional CI check).

sandbox.description: Sandbox mode, unified vocabulary (same names as Codex sandbox_mode; maps to the DSH sandbox knob). Read-only by default.

approval.description: Approval policy, unified vocabulary (→ Codex approval_policy; → DSH approval policy).

ui.description: Dynamic-UI rendering parameters (consumed by M3; BuildingOS layer, not mapped to engines).

provider.description: Memory service choice. Placeholder declaration only (D15); concrete fields after M1 research (Appendix A.7.3).
